title: TransactionReceived
description: v2 adds settlement metadata. Both new fields are OPTIONAL and postingDate widens to accept null, so a v1 producer's message still validates and a v1 consumer still finds every field it knows. This is the shape a backward-compatible change must have.

amount.description: Decimal STRING, never a JSON number. See ADR-0009.

postingDate.description: ADDED in v2, optional. Upcasting a v1 message defaults this to valueDate.

settlementSystem.description: ADDED in v2, optional. Null for v1 messages: the information was genuinely not captured, and inventing a default would be worse than a null.
